name: Xianxia
region: Chinese-inspired fictional cosmologies; must be labeled fantasy
summary: Supernatural cultivation/fantasy overlay that may borrow historical visual anchors while explicitly departing from history.

occasions.text: ritual or duel with supernatural elements

visual_arts.text: mist, spiritual light and impossible environments are fantasy signifiers, not history

incompatible_or_anachronistic.text: claiming supernatural xianxia elements are historically attested

prompt_fragments.overlay: Keep the base culture visually coherent, then make supernatural departures explicit: spiritual light should interact with surfaces, magical objects should have readable spatial logic, and fantasy should not erase clothing/material construction.

scope_note: Foundation pack: use as a bounded starting point, not an encyclopedia.
strict_reconstruction_note: Do not score xianxia fantasy elements as historical inaccuracies when the requested strictness is fantasy_hybrid.
